features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: Left-rail list of the 6 background-task scenarios. Selecting an item shows that scenario's content on the right.

Selecting an item navigates the content pane to that scenario's page

features.name: Background Task (Time Zone Change)
features.description: Registers a system-event background task for the Time Zone Change event. Register/Unregister buttons toggle registration; Status/Progress text reflect state.
expected_behaviour: Register and Unregister buttons present; Register enabled, Unregister disabled when unregistered
Clicking Register registers the task and updates Status; Unregister reverses it

features.name: Background Task with Condition
features.description: Registers a background task that runs only when a system condition is met.
expected_behaviour: Register and Unregister buttons present with the same toggle behaviour as Scenario 1

features.name: Servicing Complete Task
features.description: Registers a background task for the Servicing Complete event.

features.name: Background Task with Time Trigger
features.description: Registers a background task that fires on a time trigger.

features.name: Background Task with Application Trigger
features.description: Registers an application-trigger background task and can Signal it on demand.
expected_behaviour: Register, Unregister AND Signal buttons present (Signal distinguishes this scenario)

features.name: Grouped Background Task
features.description: Registers a grouped background task; supports unregistering grouped and ungrouped tasks separately.
expected_behaviour: Register, Unregister and 'Unregister Ungrouped Tasks' buttons present (the third button distinguishes this scenario)
